headline: Financial Analyst

experience.title: Financial Analyst
bullets: Build the monthly management report for four resorts: revenue by channel, cost per occupied room and budget variance.
Forecast cash needs 13 weeks ahead and flag shortfalls before the typhoon-season low months.
Prepared the analysis that moved laundry in-house, saving about ₱1.2 million a year.
Draft the quarterly financial statements with the external accountant and answer the board's questions.

experience.title: Budget and Finance Assistant
experience.location: Cagayan de Oro City, Misamis Oriental
bullets: Tracked spending against the annual budget for three plantations and wrote the monthly variance notes.
Maintained the fixed-asset and equipment register and reconciled it with the physical count every year.

summary: Financial analyst with four years in agribusiness and hospitality. I build management reports and cash-flow forecasts, control budgets across several business units, and turn the numbers into charts and short recommendations for owners. I have a background in economics and like connecting financial results to what is happening in the market.
skills: Data analysis and charts in Excel
